gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-sintony: Classic in spirit, Edo SZ draws its tall lowercase with one constant stroke, like cast iron capitals. Sintony follows with a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves that never clog, which is the best thing about this pairing.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans reads rounded and stencil-tidy, its tall lowercase showing a clearly open side and no thick-to-thin swing. Sofia Sans handles the quiet running text, while Edo SZ does what it does best: giving each letter a cast iron stature.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-sofia-sans-semi-con: Edo SZ draws its lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals, every stroke the same width. And Sofia Sans Semi Condensed follows with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and a wide entrance into each curve.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-sono: Plotter-pen simple, Edo SZ keeps one line weight through its cast iron lowercase. And Sono lets its tall letters spread out with wide spacing and an a left ajar, which is the pair's real charm.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-stack-sans-notch: Classic is the first word for Edo SZ, whose tall lowercase carries the stature of cast iron capitals. Stack Sans Notch has such big-bodied letters and rod-stock lines that a shrunken heading could get outweighed by it.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-stack-sans-text: Marker-simple and big-bodied, this pair keeps everything at one line width. But Edo SZ is best at standing tall like cast iron, while Stack Sans Text is best at keeping its curve endings well apart.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-sulphur-point: Classic cast iron stature sits in Edo SZ, where each lowercase letter holds a single constant stroke width. Sulphur Point does the reverse job, with bulky proportions and open gaps.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans lifts its x-height close to cap height, with a spacious opening on the c. TikTok Sans meets Edo SZ's one-pen-width simplicity with the same tall build, and that shared stature is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans has lowercase eyes as big as washers and strokes like bent copper pipe. Ubuntu Sans and Edo SZ both stand tall, and that shared stature of cast iron is the strongest thing here.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-vend-sans: Edo SZ is cast iron in lowercase form, with a constant stroke. Vend Sans draws its ruler-straight line just as constantly, with wide unclosed terminals and an x-height filling the line, which makes the two feel related.
